help.title: 🤖 Astra — Commands
about.description: Astra handles three things for your server: **verification** (keep bots and randoms out until they prove they're real), **anti-scam protection** (catch brand-new throwaway accounts on join), and a **commission ticket system** (private channels between clients and artists, with custom terms and pricing). Everything's configurable from Discord or the web dashboard — new here? Try `/quickstart`.
about.footer: Made with care — run /quickstart to get set up, or /help for the full command list.
quickstart.title: 🚀 Astra — Quickstart
quickstart.intro: A few minutes of setup and you're done. Run these roughly in order:
quickstart.step1_desc: In Server Settings → Roles, make sure Astra's role sits **above** any role she'll need to assign, and that she has Manage Roles, Manage Channels, Manage Messages, and Kick Members.
quickstart.step2_desc: Make at least one "verified member" role. Want a two-step gate (agree to rules, then verify)? Make two more: one for "rules accepted" and one for "verified".
quickstart.step3_desc: Run `/config verification` and fill in your channels and roles — or do the same thing visually from the web dashboard.
quickstart.step4_desc: Run `/config tickets`, then `/artist add` for each artist taking commissions. They can customize their own panel with `/panel`.
quickstart.step5_desc: Everything above can also be done from Astra's web dashboard — log in, pick this server, and the same settings are right there.
quickstart.footer: Run /help anytime to see every command.

onboarding.title: Help & Setup
onboarding.subtitle: How each part of Astra works, and where to configure it. Hi, {username}.
onboarding.verification.title: Verification
onboarding.verification.desc: Keeps bots and randoms out until they prove they're real. Pick a channel + role for a single Verify button, or go further with a two-step gate — a rules channel they click "I Agree" in, then a verify channel where they type {command}. Either way, a final role is what actually unlocks the rest of your server.
onboarding.antiscam.title: Anti-Scam
onboarding.antiscam.desc: Catches the classic throwaway-scam-account pattern: a brand-new Discord account with no avatar joining your server. You choose whether Astra just logs it for review, or kicks automatically.
onboarding.autokick.title: Auto-Kick
onboarding.autokick.desc: For members who never finish verification. After a grace period you set (in days), anyone still unverified gets removed automatically. Bots, the server owner, and Astra Admins are never touched by this.
onboarding.tickets.title: Commission Tickets
onboarding.tickets.desc: A member clicks "Open a Ticket," picks an artist, and gets a private channel with that artist's own Terms of Service, Won't-Do list, and pricing already posted. Register artists here or on Discord with {addCommand} — each one can customize their own panel with {panelCommand}.
onboarding.admins.title: Admin Roles
onboarding.admins.desc: By default only real server Administrators can configure Astra. If you want a Moderator role (or similar) to manage her too — without handing out full Administrator — grant that role access here.
